findings.claim: dequeue() crashes with an unhandled ValueError when the queue is empty or contains no PENDING tasks, instead of failing gracefully or returning a documented sentinel.
findings.failure_scenario: dequeue([]) -> pending = [] -> max(pending, key=lambda t: t.priority) raises 'ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence', propagating an unhandled exception; the same crash occurs for a non-empty queue whose tasks are all RUNNING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED (no PENDING tasks present).
